This '''Mandalorian super commando''' was a member of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later sided with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].

==Biography==
After building up an army of criminals including the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], and [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his army of criminals [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attacked]] [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] so the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] could come in and stop them so they could take control of the [[Mandalore/Legends|planet]]. Maul was betrayed, and locked away in [[Royal prison/Legends|Sundari prison]], but escaped and returned to [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] with his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]. Maul [[Death|slayed]] the leader of the Death Watch at that time, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], and took control of the band of warriors. This Mandalorian was one of the many who aligned with Maul after Vizsla's death.<ref name="The Lawless" />

Later, they changed their armor to give it a red design to honor the new leader of the Death Watch. This [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commando]] was stationed at the docks when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived to rescue [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Kenobi disguised himself in his [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] outfit and arrived in the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]. The Mandalorian first asked if Kenobi wanted the ship looked at since it was falling apart, but Kenobi did not want this, so the Mandalorian then asked for his landing permit. Not having one, Kenobi said he left it in the ship and had this Mandalorian come in to get it. Once inside the ship, Kenobi knocked the Mandalorian unconscious and took their armor. Kenobi then used the armor of the commando to rescue the Duchess. However, he was captured by Maul and his men. Kenobi then witnessed Maul execute Satine with the [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]].<ref name="The Lawless" />
